subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction was vacated on appeal in June 2026.

summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud in November 2023 and sentenced in March 2024; there were no credible reports that his conviction was vacated on appeal in June 2026, and the conviction remained standing as of mid‑2026.
